title_pt: Republic of Fun — Website do Estúdio
summary_en: Clean, portfolio-focused website for creative studio — showcasing work with minimal distraction.
summary_pt: Website limpo e focado em portfolio para estúdio criativo — mostrando trabalhos com mínima distração.
challenge_en: Let the studio's creative work shine while providing easy content management for regular updates.
challenge_pt: Deixar o trabalho criativo do estúdio brilhar enquanto fornece gerenciamento de conteúdo fácil para atualizações regulares.
approach_en: Minimal interface with large project imagery; intuitive filtering; fast-loading pages; custom CMS integration for team to manage portfolio.
approach_pt: Interface minimalista com imagens grandes de projetos; filtragem intuitiva; páginas de carregamento rápido; integração CMS customizada para equipe gerenciar portfolio.
outcome_en: Elegant portfolio site that increased client inquiries by 60% and simplified internal content workflow.
outcome_pt: Site de portfolio elegante que aumentou consultas de clientes em 60% e simplificou workflow interno de conteúdo.
body_en:
## Portfolio Grid

Large, filterable grid showcasing studio projects across different disciplines. Smooth transitions and hover states reveal project details without page loads.

## Project Pages

Full-bleed imagery with minimal text overlay. Process documentation, client testimonials, and related work suggestions.

## CMS Integration

Custom Craft CMS setup allowing the team to easily add projects, update case studies, and manage team bios without developer intervention.
